pixelExact.appliesWhen: The rendered state is deterministic and does not depend on third-party raster tiles, labels, live data or browser/vendor antialiasing.

visualContract.appliesWhen: A third-party renderer can vary pixels while product-controlled camera, source, layers, markers, focus, accessibility and layout remain deterministic.
requires: contract assertions sourced from the frozen V1

behavioralEquivalence.appliesWhen: The scenario represents failure, fallback or provider-unavailable behavior rather than a stable visual raster.

loading.evidence: Frozen V1/V2 loading-state comparison reached zero pixel difference in mobile, tablet and desktop.

map-ready.evidence: PR #17 Mapbox Visual Contract Regression run 31236824745 validates authenticated Mapbox GL JS 3.12.0 in mobile/tablet/desktop with the V1 camera/style contract, visible canvas, V1 route source/layers, 8 initial stops, required Mapbox logo, screenshots and zero Mapbox/page errors.

map-failure.evidence: PR #17 Map Provider Regression run 31236824741 proves both SDK download failure and Mapbox initialization failure restore the Leaflet V1 fallback in ready state without losing the initial tour markers.

tour-switch.evidence: PR #17 Map Tour Browser Regression run 31236824742 validates atomic 8→5→5→8 switching on the compatibility provider; Map Provider Regression run 31236824741 validates 8→5→5 on authenticated Mapbox. The V2 route renderer uses the same V1 source/layer IDs, line paints and fitBounds camera contract.

tour-5-stops.evidence: Authenticated Mapbox and browser regressions validate both 5-stop tours with atomic marker replacement; route source/layers and marker presentation are constrained by the frozen V1 contract.

tour-8-stops.evidence: Authenticated Mapbox starts Volta à Ilha with 8 stops and the browser regression restores 8 stops after switching tours; the V1 route source/layers and camera contract are asserted permanently.

keyboard-navigation.evidence: PR #17 Mapbox Visual Contract Regression run 31236824745 validates the functional V1 focus order in all mandatory viewports while preserving the focusable Mapbox vendor-logo link required by the SDK.

high-contrast.evidence: PR #17 Mapbox Visual Contract Regression run 31236824745 executes authenticated Mapbox under forced-colors: active in mobile/tablet/desktop, preserves the V1 route/UI contract and stores screenshots for every viewport.

enlarged-text.evidence: The V1 checkpoint established structural/visual equivalence for the normalized 200% text-enlargement protocol and preserved the responsive assistant cascade.

offline-provider-unavailable.evidence: PR #17 Map Provider Regression run 31236824741 proves provider download/init unavailability rolls back to the V1 Leaflet provider; PR #19 accessibility evidence also preserves weather provider-unavailable and network-offline states without breaking map, assistant or controls.
